title: Add append-only recovery for convergence receipt hash mismatch
objective: Preserve immutable convergence evidence while allowing one narrowly-scoped append-only correction when an otherwise semantically identical MISSION_CONVERGENCE_RECEIPT_v1 has only an invalid declared receipt_sha256. Add a versioned supersession sidecar under the existing append-only convergence evidence root, validate that the original receipt itself remains unchanged, require the corrected receipt to be byte-for-byte semantically identical except receipt_sha256, reject ambiguous/multiple or broader semantic replacements, and let the existing convergence-aware post-fix verifier consume the valid correction without weakening append-only history.

evidence.summary: The landed append-only convergence receipt has complete SATISFIED coverage but an incorrect declared receipt_sha256, so validation fails.
All configured adversarial runtime machine predicates passed; the only remaining blocker was MISSION_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED.
A one-line in-place hash correction correctly failed Automation Production Health with APPEND_ONLY_EVIDENCE_VIOLATION, proving historical convergence evidence cannot be rewritten.
Correct canonical hash of the landed convergence receipt excluding receipt_sha256; the existing declared value differs.

forbidden_changes: modifying or deleting any existing file under research/codex/convergence/
accepting semantic changes to objective, requirements, coverage, evidence, gaps, authority, candidate binding, PR binding or merge binding
accepting a supersession when the original receipt is already valid
accepting more than one applicable correction for the same base receipt
reproduction: On fresh main, run the existing convergence-aware post-fix verifier for codex-research-alpha-adversarial-runtime-wiring-v1. Observe all JSON predicates PASS and MISSION_CONVERGENCE_REQUIRED. Compute the canonical hash of research/codex/convergence/codex-research-alpha-adversarial-runtime-wiring-v1.json excluding receipt_sha256 and observe 8d2f0fdcebcfb3524eafbdd906c59b7d5a05ece42ebc91ac8c0225b5eb8e8dac while the landed declared hash differs. Attempting to edit the file in PR #1430 triggers APPEND_ONLY_EVIDENCE_VIOLATION.

positive: An invalid-hash-only base convergence receipt plus exactly one valid append-only supersession sidecar whose corrected receipt differs only in receipt_sha256 is accepted by validate_receipt.
The historical base convergence receipt remains byte-identical and the append-only evidence gate passes because recovery adds only a new sidecar.

The specific adversarial-runtime convergence receipt becomes valid through the sidecar and the existing post-fix verifier can materialize its normal completion receipt without special-casing Alpha Lab.
negative: A supersession that changes any field other than receipt_sha256 is rejected.
A supersession is rejected when the base receipt is already valid.
Zero or multiple applicable supersessions for an invalid base receipt fail closed.
A supersession with mismatched candidate_id, signature, candidate hash, task-contract hash, PR number or merge SHA is rejected.
The recovery path cannot modify/delete protected evidence and cannot bypass append-only governance.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already supports append-only invalid-hash-only convergence correction without modifying historical convergence evidence, and the adversarial runtime task no longer fails solely on the bad declared hash.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if the base adversarial convergence receipt becomes valid through an existing sanctioned recovery path or if a safe fix would require arbitrary semantic receipt replacement or weakening append-only evidence.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if recovery cannot be limited to invalid-hash-only semantic identity or requires changing Alpha, market, portfolio, API-budget or canonical authority semantics.
rollback_plan: Revert only the validator/test support for the supersession contract. Preserve the historical invalid base receipt and all supersession sidecars as audit evidence.
